items.body:
## What it does

Setup asks you to connect the lot, mail, Slack or Teams, calendars, Notion and messengers, and then it works them down instead of you checking six places. It runs on a schedule rather than waiting to be asked.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @matt_silberman shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
